# 任务树 fixture —— 验证「定义 vs 引用」检查
# 本文件不含任何游戏素材。

zz_test_missions = {
	slot = 1
	generic = yes

	# ① 正常任务：有定义、被 complete_mission 引用
	zz_mission_ok = {
		icon = mission_generic
		trigger = {
			army_size = 5
		}
		effect = {
			add_prestige = 5
			set_country_flag = zz_step1
		}
	}

	# ② 前置依赖正常的第二个任务
	zz_mission_second = {
		icon = mission_generic
		required_missions = { zz_mission_ok }
		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = zz_step1
		}
		effect = {
			add_prestige = 5
		}
	}
}
